motivation.citation: ArchiMate 3.2 Specification, Section 6; Open Group N221 reference cards, Motivation Elements

elements.name: Stakeholder
elements.summary: Role representing parties with interests in architecture effects.

elements.name: Driver
elements.summary: Condition that motivates goals and change.

elements.name: Assessment
elements.summary: Analysis result about enterprise state relative to a driver.

elements.name: Goal
elements.summary: High-level intended direction or desired end state.

elements.name: Outcome
elements.summary: End result or consequence of a state of affairs.

elements.name: Principle
elements.summary: General rule or intent that guides architecture decisions.

elements.name: Requirement
elements.summary: Need that a specific architecture system must satisfy.

elements.name: Constraint
elements.summary: Limitation on architecture or realization choices.

elements.name: Meaning
elements.summary: Interpretation or knowledge attached to a concept in context.

elements.name: Value
elements.summary: Relative worth or importance of a concept.

strategy.citation: ArchiMate 3.2 Specification, Section 7; Open Group N221 reference cards, Strategy Layer Elements

elements.name: Resource
elements.summary: Asset owned or controlled by a person or organization.

elements.name: Capability
elements.summary: Ability possessed by an active structure element.

elements.name: Value Stream
elements.summary: Sequence of activities that creates an overall result for stakeholders.

elements.name: Course of Action
elements.summary: Approach or plan for configuring resources and capabilities to achieve a goal.

business.citation: ArchiMate 3.2 Specification, Section 8; Open Group N221 reference cards, Business Layer Elements

elements.name: Business Actor
elements.summary: Business entity capable of performing behavior.

elements.name: Business Role
elements.summary: Responsibility for performing behavior.

elements.name: Business Collaboration
elements.summary: Aggregate of business active structure elements working together.

elements.name: Business Interface
elements.summary: Access point where business services are made available.

elements.name: Business Process
elements.summary: Sequence of business behaviors producing a specific result.

elements.name: Business Function
elements.summary: Collection of business behavior grouped by criteria.

elements.name: Business Interaction
elements.summary: Collective business behavior performed by multiple business actors or roles.

elements.name: Business Event
elements.summary: Business-related state change.

elements.name: Business Service
elements.summary: Exposed business behavior provided to an environment.

elements.name: Business Object
elements.summary: Concept used within a business domain.

elements.name: Contract
elements.summary: Agreement specification between provider and consumer.

elements.name: Representation
elements.summary: Perceptible form of information carried by a business object.

elements.name: Product
elements.summary: Coherent offering of services or passive structure elements with a contract.

application.citation: ArchiMate 3.2 Specification, Section 9; Open Group N221 reference cards, Application Layer Elements

elements.name: Application Component
elements.summary: Modular and replaceable encapsulation of application functionality.

elements.name: Application Collaboration
elements.summary: Aggregate of application active structure elements working together.

elements.name: Application Interface
elements.summary: Access point where application services are made available.

elements.name: Application Function
elements.summary: Automated behavior performed by an application component.

elements.name: Application Interaction
elements.summary: Collective application behavior performed by multiple components.

elements.name: Application Process
elements.summary: Sequence of application behaviors producing a result.

elements.name: Application Event
elements.summary: Application state change.

elements.name: Application Service
elements.summary: Explicitly defined exposed application behavior.

elements.name: Data Object
elements.summary: Data structured for automated processing.

technology.citation: ArchiMate 3.2 Specification, Section 10; Open Group N221 reference cards, Technology Layer Elements

elements.name: Node
elements.summary: Computational or physical resource that hosts or interacts with resources.

elements.name: Device
elements.summary: Physical IT resource for storing or executing software and artifacts.

elements.name: System Software
elements.summary: Software environment for storing, executing, or using software or data.

elements.name: Technology Collaboration
elements.summary: Aggregate of technology active structure elements working together.

elements.name: Technology Interface
elements.summary: Access point for technology services.

elements.name: Path
elements.summary: Link through which technology elements exchange data, energy, or material.

elements.name: Communication Network
elements.summary: Structures and behaviors connecting devices or system software.

elements.name: Technology Function
elements.summary: Collection of technology behavior performed by technology active structure.

elements.name: Technology Process
elements.summary: Sequence of technology behaviors producing a result.

elements.name: Technology Interaction
elements.summary: Collective technology behavior performed by multiple technology elements.

elements.name: Technology Event
elements.summary: Technology state change.

elements.name: Technology Service
elements.summary: Explicitly defined exposed technology behavior.

elements.name: Artifact
elements.summary: Deployable data used or produced by development, deployment, or operation.

elements.name: Equipment
elements.summary: Physical machine, tool, or instrument for creating or transforming materials.

elements.name: Facility
elements.summary: Physical structure or environment.

elements.name: Distribution Network
elements.summary: Physical network transporting materials or energy.

elements.name: Material
elements.summary: Tangible physical matter or energy.
